customManagers.description: Generic: '# renovate:' comments above Dockerfile ARG version pins

packageRules.description: Postgres majors need a deliberate decision (a new major means a data-directory upgrade for every consumer)

PGDG apt pins. The deb datasource requires an explicit index URL (suite/components/binaryArch); it is context for Renovate, not an endpoint it calls. binaryArch=amd64 picks the index to read versions from — PGDG publishes the same version string for every architecture, and the Dockerfile pin is arch-independent.

edtf-postgres is consumed as an OCI build stage, so the native Dockerfile manager tracks it and bumps tag and digest in one PR — nothing here is hand-edited, which is why this replaced the release-tarball pin and its two per-arch SHA256 args. Tags are <version>-pg<major>; Renovate's docker versioning holds the -pg18 suffix constant, so moving postgres majors stays the deliberate decision the rule above makes it rather than arriving inside an extension bump. Sibling crates (edtf-wasm and friends) release at the same version but publish no image, so they can no longer bump this at all. First-party (published by this owner), so the shared preset's cooldown — which guards against upstream account takeover — is waived; `task scan:edtf` re-proves the attestation against whatever digest the bump lands on.
